name: Jake Ashby

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to Robert Bornt
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Petersburg, county of Rensselaer, to Robert Bornt.

sponsored.t: Removes residency requirements for Washington county deputy county attorneys
sponsored.sum: Removes residency requirements for Washington county deputy county attorneys, provided that they live in Washington county or an adjoining county within the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York mosquito surveillance act
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of environmental conservation to establish a New York mosquito surveillance task force to study and assess the future of mosquito surveillance in the state; directs a plan to be submitted after one year of effectiveness; directs counties to develop and submit plans of action to begin, continue, or expand mosquito surveillance.

sponsored.t: Makes all costs and expenses of the department of public service and public service commission subject to appropriation by the legislature; repealer
sponsored.sum: Makes all costs and expenses of the department of public service and public service commission subject to appropriation by the legislature on the certification of the chair of the department and upon the audit and warrant of the comptroller.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Ryan J. St. Gelais and Aaron M. St. Gelais, police officers in the village of Menands, county of Albany, to receive certain credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Ryan J. St. Gelais and Aaron M. St. Gelais, police officers in the village of Menands, county of Albany, to receive certain credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law and to apply for reinstatement with the NY state and local police and fire retirement system.

sponsored.t: Relates to capital upgrades to certain residential health care facilities
sponsored.sum: Ensures that publicly-sponsored residential health care facilities and facilities that receive grants under the Statewide Health Care Facility Transformation program are not subject to outdated total project cost caps or excessive project equity requirements.

sponsored.t: Provides that coverage for outpatient diagnosis and treatment of substance use disorder shall not be subject to preauthorization
sponsored.sum: Provides that coverage for outpatient diagnosis and treatment of substance use disorder shall not be subject to preauthorization.
sponsored.fis: : To be determined, provided savings should accrue as those ready for recovery can access outpatient care quicker and avoid the costly conse- quences of returning to abusing substances.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of transportation to construct and install safety gates at a certain railroad crossing in the village of Castleton-on-Hudson, county of Rensselaer
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of transportation to construct and install safety gates at a certain railroad crossing in the village of Castleton-on-Hudson, county of Rensselaer within 2 years of the effective date.

sponsored.t: Prohibits safety and emission inspections for new motor vehicles that are sold or transferred
sponsored.sum: Prohibits safety and emission inspections for new motor vehicles that are sold or transferred until the third year after the initial inspection by a dealer.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of the small business child & dependent care savings program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the small business child and dependent care savings program; provides the basic framework therefor.
sponsored.fis: Administrative costs to the State associated with the running the program.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain disabled veterans from real property taxation
sponsored.sum: Exempts disabled veterans rated as such by the US Department of Veterans affairs from real property taxation for their primary residence.

sponsored.t: Proposes a constitutional amendment to increase the terms of office of members of the legislature to four years
sponsored.sum: Proposes a constitutional amendment to increase the terms of office of members of the legislature to four years and limit the terms of office a member of the legislature may serve.

sponsored.t: Relates to immigration enforcement
sponsored.sum: Relates to state and local law enforcement agency coordination with the federal government for purposes of immigration enforcement, to the release of noncitizen incarcerated individuals for federal immigration purposes, and to immigration enforcement in sensitive locations.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of health to conduct a study on kratom use by humans
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to conduct a study on kratom use by humans and to submit a report on such study after one year.

sponsored.t: Establishes a New York state child care expansion program within the office of general services
sponsored.sum: Establishes a New York state child care expansion program within the office of general services to assist state agencies with establishing a physical location whereby each state office shall allow a private child day care center to operate.

sponsored.t: Establishes a municipal solar planning grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a municipal solar planning grant program for municipalities to receive grants for plans to develop solar energy systems on agricultural land and commercially-zoned properties in such municipalities; creates a database to track such solar energy system distribution.

sponsored.t: Eliminates the registration fee for gold star mother and gold star family member distinctive license plates
sponsored.sum: Provides for distinctive license plates for gold star family members; eliminates the registration fee for gold star mother and gold star family member distinctive license plates.

sponsored.t: Eliminates registration fees for distinctive plates for gold star mothers
sponsored.sum: Eliminates registration fees for distinctive plates for gold star mothers.

sponsored.t: Expands farm brewery, cidery, winery and distillery privileges
sponsored.sum: Expands the privileges of farm breweries, cideries, wineries and distilleries to allow for the sales of "farm brewed" alcoholic beverages for off-premises consumption.

sponsored.t: Relates to using a portion of the public safety communications surcharge to support volunteer fire department initiatives
sponsored.sum: Relates to using a portion of the public safety communications surcharge to support volunteer fire department initiatives; establishes the New York state volunteer fire department auxiliary fund.
sponsored.fis: 41.7% of funds collected from PSCS will now be diverted away from the general fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a tax credit for taxpayers who purchase and install a water filtration or purification system in their residence or business
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating a tax credit for taxpayers who purchase and install a water filtration or purification system in their residence or business.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the health care worker peer support program
sponsored.sum: Enacts the health care worker peer support program.

sponsored.t: Creates a statewide central register of elder abuse and maltreatment reports and the elder justice coordinating council
sponsored.sum: Creates a statewide central register of elder abuse and maltreatment reports and the elder justice coordinating council; mandates reporting by certain persons; facilitates interagency planning and reviews specific agency initiatives for their impact on the reporting and investigation of elder abuse and maltreatment in the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a green alert system for missing military members
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a green alert system for missing military members.

sponsored.t: Designates the animal control officer in the town of Sand Lake as a peace officer
sponsored.sum: Designates the animal control officer in the town of Sand Lake as a peace officer.

sponsored.t: Permits municipalities the local option of providing a tax exemption to National Guard members and reservists
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax exemption for U.S. military reservists and members of the National Guard.

sponsored.t: Eliminates ability of legislators to earn certain perks
sponsored.sum: Eliminates ability of legislators to earn certain perks associated with transportation, including, but not limited to, frequent-flier miles and reward points for hotel stays.

sponsored.t: Relates to addiction counseling services for incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Relates to addiction counseling services for incarcerated individuals.

sponsored.t: Relates to the preservation of electronic mail
sponsored.sum: Relates to the preservation of electronic mail for a period of seven years.

sponsored.t: Relates to paid family leave and bereavement for fetal death, still birth, and an infant being medically not viable to survive
sponsored.sum: Relates to paid family leave and bereavement for fetal death, still birth, and an infant being medically not viable to survive.

sponsored.t: Relates to adding veterans to protected classes for unlawful housing discrimination
sponsored.sum: Relates to adding veterans to protected classes for unlawful housing discrimination.
sponsored.fis: None to the state for this legislation; if discrimination occurs, the Human Rights Division may have more cases to investigate.

sponsored.t: Designates restaurants as qualified businesses for the purposes of the commercial security tax credit program
sponsored.sum: Designates restaurants as qualified businesses for the purposes of the commercial security tax credit program.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing farm laborers to decide to work on a day of rest
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing farm laborers to decide to work on a day of rest.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "New York's Own combat veterans healthcare choice program act" to establish tax free savings accounts to pay the healthcare costs of certain combat veterans until covered by the federal government
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "New York's Own combat veterans healthcare choice program act" to establish tax free savings accounts to pay the healthcare costs of combat veterans on active duty during Operation Enduring Freedom or Operation Iraqi Freedom, until covered by the federal government; directs the division of military and naval affairs to establish a registry of Afghanistan and Iraq veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to the scheduling of a fact finding hearing after the issuance of a temporary order of protection in family court
sponsored.sum: Relates to the scheduling of a fact finding hearing after the issuance of a temporary order of protection in family court; provides that such hearing shall be scheduled no later than 14 days after the temporary order is issued.

sponsored.t: Requires age verification for internet pornography websites
sponsored.sum: Requires age verification for internet pornography websites; imposes a $50,000 penalty per day for violations; provides exemptions for news organizations.

sponsored.t: Creates a jobs development incentive income tax credit available to employers who employ individuals previously receiving unemployment
sponsored.sum: Creates a jobs development incentive income tax credit available to employers who employ individuals previously receiving unemployment.

sponsored.t: Provides a tax credit for certain utility bill payments and establishes a moratorium on certain surcharges thereon
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax credit for utility bill payments made in taxable years 2025 and 2026 based on the difference of the average monthly utility bill payment in the year in which the credit is claimed and the average monthly utility bill payment in the preceding three taxable years; establishes a moratorium on certain utility bill surcharges until April 1, 2026; provides for the repeal of such moratorium upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to a business tax credit for purchase of data breach insurance
sponsored.sum: Relates to a business tax credit for purchase of data breach insurance.

sponsored.t: Establishes a hydroelectric power tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a hydroelectric power tax credit.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state preceptor stipend program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state preceptor stipend program to be administered by the office of the professions, under which qualified preceptor clinicians shall receive a $5,000 stipend; provides for such funds to be distributed from the office of the professions account.

sponsored.t: Creates an adoption tax credit
sponsored.sum: Creates an adoption tax credit in the amount of fifty percent of qualified adoption expenses, or ten thousand dollars, whichever is less.

sponsored.t: Relates to payment of a supplemental empire state child tax credit
sponsored.sum: Relates to payment of a supplemental empire state child tax credit for the tax year 2024 and thereafter equal to $1000 per qualified newborn.

sponsored.t: Adjusts the school tax relief (STAR) exemption for homes located outside New York city (Part A); relates to a real property tax freeze (Part B); and relates to supplemental state assistance (Part C)
sponsored.sum: Adjusts the school tax relief (STAR) exemption for homes located outside a city with a population greater than one million for the 2025--2026 school years and thereafter (Part A); relates to a real property tax freeze to reimburse qualifying homeowners for increases in local property taxes on their primary residences (Part B); provides for supplemental state assistance to be paid to cities, counties, towns and villages that are compliant with the property tax levy limits (Part C).
sponsored.fis: The cost to the state will be offset by budgetary considerations and outmigration reversal.

sponsored.t: Allows courts to consider the risk of continued substance abuse
sponsored.sum: Allows courts to consider the risk of continued substance abuse and likelihood of serious harm to the principal when considering committing such principal to the custody of the sheriff.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of health to conduct a study on the use of ibogaine as a treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health, in conjunction with the commissioners of mental health and veterans' services, to conduct a study on the use of ibogaine as a treatment for post-traumatic stress disorder, and the increasing rate of PTSD diagnoses in veterans and first responders.

sponsored.t: Establishes a local government salt brine equipment grant program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes a local government salt brine equipment grant program under which the secretary of state may award matching grants to municipalities to cover costs associated with purchasing salt brine equipment.

sponsored.t: Relates to updating rate components for the non-capital component of rates of payment by governmental agencies for inpatient services provided by residential health care facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring rate components for the non-capital component of rates of payment by governmental agencies for inpatient services provided by residential health care facilities to be updated no later than 1/1/2027, and every 5 years thereafter using the most currently available cost report data.

sponsored.t: Requires approval by a two-thirds vote of the state senate for certain salary increases of certain state officers
sponsored.sum: Requires approval by a two-thirds vote of the state senate for certain salary increases of certain state officers that would result in a salary above the governor's salary.

sponsored.t: Requires that regents and elective officers of the university of the state of New York prove that their primary residence is located within New York state before entering on their duties
sponsored.sum: Requires that regents and elective officers of the university of the state of New York prove that their primary residence is located within New York state before entering on their duties.

sponsored.t: Relates to veteran information collected by certain facilities
sponsored.sum: Requires nursing homes, residential health care facilities, and adult care facilities to ask patients if they have a service-connected disability rating from the federal department of veterans affairs; requires such information to be delivered to the department of veterans' services and transmitted to city and county veterans' services agencies and officers.

sponsored.t: Establishes the shovel-ready housing program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the shovel-ready housing program under which certain municipalities, at their option, may pre-authorize parcels of property for the construction of housing; establishes a shovel-ready community tax rebate for taxpayers residing in municipalities that opt-in to the shovel-ready housing program; provides for annual apportionment to municipalities that have certified participation in the shovel-ready housing program.

sponsored.t: Exempts veterans eighty-five years of age and older from the obligation to pay New York state income tax
sponsored.sum: Exempts veterans eighty-five years of age and older from the obligation to pay New York state income tax.

sponsored.t: Relates to patient counseling before issuing a prescription for a schedule II opioid
sponsored.sum: Relates to patient counseling before issuing a prescription for a schedule II opioid; requires practitioners to consult with the patient regarding the quantity of the opioid and the patient's option to fill the prescription in a lesser quantity, and to inform the patient of the risks associated with opiate addiction and document the reason for the prescription.

sponsored.t: Increases the child and dependent care tax credit
sponsored.sum: Increases the child and dependent care tax credit to reflect increases in the cost of child and dependent care.

sponsored.t: Creates an in vitro fertilization treatment tax credit
sponsored.sum: Creates an in vitro fertilization treatment tax credit for up to three cycles of in vitro fertilization treatment for expenses related to treatment for infertility.

sponsored.t: Requires prescription containers for opioid medications to have a red cap top and a printed warning
sponsored.sum: Requires prescription containers for opioid medications to have a red cap top and a printed warning about the risks of overdose and addiction.

sponsored.t: Allows reservists who have served or who are currently serving in the United States armed forces to be eligible for 2.5 points on civil service examinations
sponsored.sum: Allows reservists who have served or who are currently serving in the United States armed forces to be eligible for 2.5 points on civil service examinations.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting the appointment of school resource officers to private elementary and secondary schools
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the sheriff of certain counties to appoint school resource officers to private elementary and secondary schools upon the request of such private school and the approval of the county legislative body.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of criminal sale of a controlled substance upon the grounds of a drug or alcohol treatment center, or alcoholics anonymous or narcotics anonymous meeting
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of criminal sale of a controlled substance upon the grounds of a drug or alcohol treatment center, or alcoholics anonymous or narcotics anonymous meeting; designates such crime as a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Establishes an inventory database to track the state's inventory of unused state-owned real property
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of general services to establish an inventory database to track the state's inventory of unused state-owned real property; directs state agencies to appoint inventory coordinators to report such agencies' inventory of unused state-owned real property to the office of general services to maintain the inventory database.

sponsored.t: Relates to the classification of certain crimes relating to assaults on police officers
sponsored.sum: Relates to the classification of certain crimes relating to assaults on police officers; increases such classifications by one level.

sponsored.t: Establishes the retire strong tax credit for certain individuals age 65 or older
sponsored.sum: Establishes the retire strong tax credit for certain individuals age 65 or older; authorizes a tax credit amounting to half the qualifying real property taxes paid by such individual for the taxable year, up to $6,500.

sponsored.t: Classifies possession of fentanyl as criminal possession of a controlled substance in the fifth degree
sponsored.sum: Classifies possession of substances containing fentanyl, carfentanyl, or analogs thereof as criminal possession of a controlled substance in the fifth degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to participation by veterans with respect to state contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to participation by veterans with respect to state contracts by expanding Article 3 of the veterans' services law to cover all veteran-owned business enterprises instead of only service-disabled veteran-owned business enterprises; makes related corrections in law.

sponsored.t: Establishes the school safety specialist act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the school safety specialist act; establishes a certification and training program for school safety specialists; outlines the roles and duties of school safety specialists.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of environmental conservation to undertake a review of the regulations governing the permitting of landfills and transfer stations
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of environmental conservation to undertake a review of the regulations governing the permitting of landfills and transfer stations to ensure that such regulations integrate the latest scientific information.

sponsored.t: Relates to unlawful possession or sale of imitation drug paraphernalia
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of unlawful possession or sale of imitation drug paraphernalia when such person knowingly possesses, purchases, delivers, sells, or possesses with intent to sell or deliver any punch, die, plate, stone, pill press, tableting machine, encapsulating machine or any other equipment in order to print, imprint, or reproduce the trademark, trade name or other identifying mark, imprint or device of another or any likeness of any of the foregoing upon any substance or container or labeling thereof knowing, intending, or having reasonable cause to believe that it will be used to manufacture an imitation drug.

sponsored.t: Allows persons in recovery to have a distinguishing mark printed on their license for cases of medical emergencies
sponsored.sum: Allows persons in recovery to have a distinguishing mark printed on their driver's license for cases of medical emergencies.

sponsored.t: Establishes a mental wellness group pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a mental wellness group pilot program to partner with insurance companies to facilitate group therapy sessions for children ages ten through eighteen.

sponsored.t: Phases out certain reimbursements for expenditures made by or on behalf of social services districts for medical assistance for needy persons
sponsored.sum: Phases out certain reimbursements for expenditures made by or on behalf of social services districts for medical assistance for needy persons, beginning with a 10% reduction for 2025, and ending with a 100% reduction for 2034, and remaining eliminated for each year thereafter.
sponsored.fis: Savings to property taxpayers living in localities subject to the two percent property tax cap and approximately $400 million in Fiscal Year 2025, $2 billion in Fiscal Year 2029, and $4 billion in Fiscal Year 2034 in cost to the state.

sponsored.t: Establishes a New York state English as a new language teaching assistance program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a New York state English as a new language teaching assistance program for certain undergraduate and/or graduate students in a program leading to a career as a teacher in primary or secondary education.

sponsored.t: Provides for state reimbursement for lost tax revenue due to devaluation of land as a result of toxic contamination
sponsored.sum: Provides for state reimbursement for lost tax revenue due to devaluation of land as a result of toxic contamination.

sponsored.t: Establishes the veterans' services organization capital support program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the veterans' services organization capital support program to provide funding to eligible entities for payment of the capital costs of construction, improvement, repairs, rehabilitation, or reconstruction of facilities owned by eligible entities, and for the acquisition of related equipment with a useful life of not less than ten years; appropriates a sum of $10,000,000 therefor.
sponsored.fis: $10 million to the state, no fiscal impact on local governments.

sponsored.t: Allows first responders who are diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder to request line of duty sick leave
sponsored.sum: Allows first responders who are diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder to request line of duty sick leave.

sponsored.t: Exempts from the mortgage recording tax mortgages executed by a veteran first time homebuyer
sponsored.sum: Exempts from the mortgage recording tax mortgages executed by a veteran first time homebuyer.

sponsored.t: Relates to prehospital emergency medical services for individuals in substance use recovery
sponsored.sum: Relates to prehospital emergency medical services for individuals in substance use recovery; requires policies, procedures, and protocols to be developed to identify individuals in substance use recovery and to avoid treatment that could compromise such individuals' recovery.

sponsored.t: Establishes a small business tax credit for certain efforts taken to improve such small business's facility in an effort to reduce the spread of infectious diseases
sponsored.sum: Establishes a small business tax credit for certain efforts taken to improve such small business's facility in an effort to reduce the spread of infectious diseases.

sponsored.t: Relates to grand larceny in the fourth degree
sponsored.sum: Adds a person having been previously convicted of petit larceny two times within any three month period or three times within any twelve month period to the definition of grand larceny in the fourth degree.

sponsored.t: Exempts student organizations from sales taxes on certain prepared foods sold
sponsored.sum: Exempts student organizations from sales taxes on prepared foods where total revenues from sales are below two hundred fifty dollars.

sponsored.t: Requires local child protective services to notify appropriate military personnel when a member of the armed forces is the subject of a report of child abuse or maltreatment
sponsored.sum: Requires local child protective services to notify appropriate military personnel when a member of the armed forces is the subject of a report of child abuse or maltreatment; allows military law enforcement personnel to inquire of local child protective services whether any member of the armed forces is the subject of an indicated report on file with the statewide central register of child abuse and maltreatment.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the acquisition of real property by foreign countries and entities of particular concern
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the acquisition of real property by foreign countries and entities of particular concern as well as citizens, companies, entities, and members of such countries and entities.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to conduct a study on opening three new veterans nursing homes in New York state and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to conduct a study on opening three new veterans nursing homes in New York state; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to the elimination of bail; repealer
sponsored.sum: Eliminates bail for all offenses; provides for imposition of restrictions and conditions and remand for certain offenses; directs consideration of a defendant's character, reputation, habits, mental condition, activities and history, and whether they pose a danger to themselves, another person or the community, when determining a securing order; creates the commission on public safety reform to issue a determination on which offenses should be eligible for pretrial detention.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to establish a right to preventative maintenance of wheelchairs program
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to establish a right to preventative maintenance of wheelchairs program, after consultation with certain other offices, under which owners of manual and powered wheelchairs shall be entitled to reimbursement of certain preventative maintenance costs for such wheelchairs.

sponsored.t: Establishes a weekend child day care assistance program for New York army and air national guard members
sponsored.sum: Establishes a weekend child day care assistance program to provide for child day care at a child care provider for New York army and air national guard members on drill weekends.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Kristin Proud to receive certain service credit with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Kristin Proud to receive certain service credit with the New York state and local employees' retirement system for her volunteer service beginning March 25, 2020 and ending November 8, 2020.
sponsored.fis: Fiscal note attached; past service cost of approximately $20,800 which will be borne by the State of New York as a one-time payment.

sponsored.t: Requires a report on the utilization and activity of the statewide fiscal intermediary
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of health to produce a report on the utilization and activity of the statewide fiscal intermediary with regard to metrics for certain medical assistance programs for needy persons; requires such report to be published no later than sixty days after effectiveness.

sponsored.t: Relates to military service qualifying for military service credit
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain military service credit from being included in calculations of up to three years of military service credit for a public retirement system of the state.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Christopher P. Mayr to receive certain credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Christopher P. Mayr to receive certain credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law for service as a fire fighter employed by the city of Rensselaer.

sponsored.t: Relates to circumstances under which a consumer may be subject to a new special open enrollment period to choose a new health insurance plan
sponsored.sum: Allows for a new special open enrollment period to choose a new health insurance plan for consumers in certain instances to allow for continuity of care with an existing health care provider.

sponsored.t: Expands eligibility under the veterans tuition awards program to include recipients of the award of the Purple Heart
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility under the veterans tuition awards program to include recipients of the award of the Purple Heart.

sponsored.t: Establishes the commission to investigate foreign influence on governmental employees and elections
sponsored.sum: Establishes the commission to investigate foreign influence on governmental employees and elections.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Colonie
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Colonie; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2030.

sponsored.t: Relates to training stipends paid by the office of fire prevention and control to volunteer firefighters
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of fire prevention and control to pay training stipends in specific amounts to volunteer firefighters for completion of certain firefighter trainings; provides that if a volunteer fire company pays training stipends to volunteer firefighters in an amount below what is otherwise required to be paid by OFPC, OFPC shall pay the remaining amount.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a transfer student appeal process
sponsored.sum: Establishes a transfer student appeal process to provide students with an option to pursue a second opinion regarding the status of their transfer credits from out-of-state schools, out-of-country schools, or non-public schools.

sponsored.t: Sets fees for gold star family distinctive plates at the same rate as for gold star mothers
sponsored.sum: Sets fees for gold star family distinctive plates at the same rate as for gold star mothers.

sponsored.t: Establishes the thriving reliable inexpensive versatile energy council; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals the New York state climate leadership and community protection act and establishes the nineteen member common sense energy council which will prepare and approve recommendations for achieving affordable and attainable statewide greenhouse gas reductions; requires a statewide greenhouse gas emissions report by the department of environmental conservation; makes technical corrections thereto.

sponsored.t: Relates to dependent care flexible benefits
sponsored.sum: Directs certain employers to establish a dependent care flexible benefits program under which a portion of employees' compensations are deposited directly into dependent care flexible spending accounts.

sponsored.t: Relates to capital improvement costs pursuant to which a manufactured home park may increase rent above three percent
sponsored.sum: Defines the types of capital improvement costs pursuant to which a manufactured home park may increase rent above three percent over the previous rent price.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier II membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to Javier-Luis I. Martinez
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier II membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to Javier-Luis I. Martinez, a current member of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system employed by the town of Colonie.
sponsored.fis: Fiscal note attached; past service cost of approximately $4,610 which will be borne by the town of Colonie as a one-time payment.

sponsored.t: Relates to retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Philip Apruzzese
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Philip Apruzzese.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization of the county of Rensselaer to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization of the county of Rensselaer to impose an additional one percent of sales and compensating use taxes until November 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Designates the state of New York a purple heart state
sponsored.sum: Designates the state of New York a purple heart state.

sponsored.t: Establishes the Capital Region preceptor stipend program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the Capital Region preceptor stipend program to be administered by the office of the professions, under which qualified preceptor clinicians shall receive a $5,000 stipend; provides for such funds to be distributed from the office of the professions account.
